messages:
anya (docs): quick sync — product asked for a short public-facing deprecation note + a detailed migration guide for v1 -> v2 text endpoints. we need copy, sample snippets, and a small FAQ. who can own? :wave:
rafa (eng): i can own the migration doc content. will need exact list of API surface changes from SDK team.
cheng (sdk): breaking changes we plan to call out: header rename (Authorization -> x-rw-api-key), responses API shape (generate -> responses.create), and streaming frame format updated. i'll paste minimal snippets.
anya (docs): thanks. request: include both minimal curl example and a tiny JS example. keep the quick banner sentence under 80 chars. also need a console banner suggestion and email subject line.
harper (product): note: retiring model alias redwood/text-alpha on 2026-06-15 23:59UTC. we'll provide a 45-day notice starting 2026-05-01. doc must state rollback/fallback options and contract exceptions.
rafa (eng): added: infra accepts 45-day banner. also add troubleshooting section about 502 vs 404 on pinned models.
cheng (sdk): JS snippet for docs (drop-in):
```js
// v1
import RW from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const c = new RW({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.generate({ model: 'redwood/text-alpha', prompt: 'hi' });

// v2
import { Redwood } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await r.responses.create({ model: 'redwood/text-v2', input: 'hi' });
```
anya (docs): great — i'll include a 3-line quickstart and keep this as the appendix snippet. also add a token-delta note (v2 counts tokens differently).
harper (product): suggested banner copy: "Deprecation: v1 text endpoints retiring 2026-06-15. See migration guide." short enough?
rafa (eng): fine. add link to opt-in grace policy text: "contact support to maintain v1 access for contracts."
cheng (sdk): streaming note: older SDKs may drop frames and interleave meta frames differently. advise customers to use SDK >= 2.1.0. we'll add a small code sample showing how to handle partial frames.
anya (docs): example curl header change for FAQ (please confirm):
```bash
# v1
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# v2
curl -H "x-rw-api-key: $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```
cheng (sdk): correct — header changed to x-rw-api-key for v2. add both so ops teams can grep for old usage.
rafa (eng): PR plan: i'll open the docs PR with migration guide + banner copy + FAQ checklist. can we get SDK README note linked from there?
cheng (sdk): i'll open a tiny PR in the JS SDK to add a migration section and point to the docs PR. PR numbers to drop in here when ready.
infra-bot: Canary rollout record: text-v2 service deployed to eu-west-1 at 2026-05-02T03:12:00Z.
anya (docs): awesome. action items summary: 1) rafa opens docs PR with draft and banner text, 2) cheng updates SDK README and adds snippets, 3) harper to finalize announcement schedule, 4) docs to publish FAQ and migration appendix. please ping when PRs are ready for review.
rafa (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2489 — draft migration guide, checklist in place. will add email subject samples shortly.
cheng (sdk): SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/412 — adds migration note and code snippets.
anya (docs): thank you! i'll prep the console banner copy and draft the customer email. tentative merge date: 2026-05-03 so we can start banners on 2026-05-01 if approved.
harper (product): confirmed. will schedule marketing review and legal signoff.
anya (docs): last check — any objections to including a short troubleshooting table: 404 (model retired), 401 (header mismatch), 502 (proxy transient)?
rafa (eng): fine by infra. include recommended remediation steps per row.
cheng (sdk): also add a note about model aliasing and how to pin to a specific sha/version in the model registry. i'll send the cli command snippet.
anya (docs): perfect. i'll merge once both PRs have cross-links and approvals. please react with :thumbsup: on the PRs when you've reviewed. thanks everyone! :tada:
